Unboxing
Your mattress will arrive compressed and rolled in a compact box. We recommend unboxing it within 30 days of delivery. Simply remove it from the box and carefully cut the plastic wrap.

Rest Time
Once unpacked, the mattress will regain its shape very quickly. You only need to wait 2 to 3 hours before you can sleep on it for the first time.
